description: Standard header for onboarding steps 1-3 (step 0 has none): step-internal BackButton, centered title, optional Skip. Replaces the bespoke bottom chevron nav + 'Step N of 4' counter.

title.description: Short step title (e.g. 'Invite Partner', 'Link a Bank', 'Your CoupleFlow Journey')

showBack.description: Render the BackButton (false on the finish step if desired; absent entirely on step 0)

onBack.description: Decrements currentStep — passed to BackButton's onPress so it drives the step machine, NOT router navigation

onSkip.description: When present, renders a right-aligned Skip text button (steps 1 & 2)

layout.spacerWidth: match BackButton width (40) when no skip, to keep title centered
